text:
jamie: Noticing a small but consistent stream of strict schema rejects from fncall in ap-southeast-1. Error payload:
```json
{"error":"type_mismatch","path":"response.items","expected":"object","got":"array"}
```
Mostly from a handful of API keys. tagging @sophia @derek for triage

sophia: Thanks. Do we have rollout metadata for strict-output-v4? Also, we keep losing account_id in these events if validation happens before routing. That breaks attribution and dashboard filters.

audit-bot: Canary status: feature=strict-output-v4, region=ap-southeast-1, rollout_pct=9, status=running

maya: Short-term options: 1) toggle strict-output-v4->soft-accept so we don't block customers, 2) keep strict and add better sampling + payload capture with redaction. I prefer soft-accept + telemetry so we avoid user-facing errors while we investigate.

derek: Soft-accept is ok if we: a) tag events with schema_mode=soft_accept and orig_error=TYPE_MISMATCH; b) ensure original route_id and account_id are preserved for quota billing; c) have a separate metric fncall.schema.soft_accepts. Also bump full-payload redaction capture to 2% for these errors.

sophia: I'll add the event fields and the alert: page eng-oncall if soft_accept rate >0.3% or >200/min. Dashboard: "schema soft accepts by account" + top offending schema paths.

jamie: Can we redact PII before storing samples? We need a short redaction whitelist: keep keys: user_id (hashed), trace_id, but remove content fields. Will open a privacy ticket.

maya: Let's proceed. Derek flip the canary to soft-accept and annotate with soft-accept-temp=true. Sophia: telemetry + alert PR please. Jamie: collect redacted samples and link ticket INF-4950.

derek: Flip done. strict-output-v4 -> SOFT-ACCEPT, rollout_pct reduced to 3 in ap-southeast-1. Logged in rollout feed.

audit-bot: Change recorded by deploy-user on 2024-06-10T09:14:12Z

sophia: PR opened for telemetry and alert: https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-317. Will include enum mapping for error codes (TYPE_MISMATCH, EXTRA_FIELDS, MISSING_REQUIRED, UNPARSEABLE) so dashboards are consistent.

jamie: Filing INF-4950 with redaction examples. Will attach 10 redacted samples.

maya: Action list summarized in INF-4950. We'll keep soft-accept for now and reassess after telemetry data comes in. Closing thread here. :thumbsup:
